Title: General availability: Stream Analytics tools for Visual Studio

Body.Content:
To help maximize end-to-end developer productivity across authoring, testing, and debugging Stream Analytics jobs, Azure Stream Analytics tools for Visual Studio are now generally available.

One of the tools' key capabilities is local testing on client machines to enable true offline query building and testing experiences. The tools also include features like IntelliSense (code completion), syntax highlighting, error markers, and source control integrations.
